summary: Iteration 10 — ACTUAL EXECUTION of Layer #7 'User Edit Diffing'. Ran 13 pytest cases against the public preview URL (13/13 passed) covering Chain.build_manifest/built_at exposure, check-edits upload path, dedup on identical re-upload, nested-folder path normalization, bad-zip/400/404/409 edge cases, and persisted GET /edit-diffs history. Also ran two Playwright frontend passes on the fixture chain in ChainViewer: check-edits-btn renders alongside open-push/download-chain, opens a native file chooser (hidden input accept='.zip'), zip upload produces a sonner toast 'found 1 corrected file(s)' and renders edit-diffs-panel with expandable edit-diff-index.html / edit-diff-README.md details showing the real unified diff containing the uploaded marker. Pricing page + landing regression smoke OK. Code inspection confirmed `if file is not None` is evaluated BEFORE `elif doc.get('github')` in server.py check_edits (priority-order fix present). No blocking issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: Optimistically-merged diff entries added right after an upload lack seconds_since_build, so the '(Xm after build)' label is missing for the just-uploaded file until reload (server-fetched rows show it). Cosmetic only.

issues: Repeated 401 console errors on load (Neon Auth token/me calls while anonymous) — functionally harmless but noisy; consider suppressing the request when no auth session cookie exists.

action_items: Optional (LOW): populate seconds_since_build (or omit label gracefully) on optimistic post-upload diff entries in ChainViewer.runCheckEdits.
Optional (LOW): skip Neon Auth token fetch when no session exists to remove the 401 console noise.
Cleanup: my 409 test invoked POST /api/evolve once ('TEST_IT10 a tiny hello page'), leaving one extra chain in the anonymous history for session selftest-edits-1787072853.
critical_code_review_comments: edits.py _store_diff dedup compares only against the single most recent hunk for a file; A->B->A toggling still appends a duplicate row. Acceptable for an append-only history but worth noting for corrections_digest noise.

_normalize_upload_paths strips exactly one leading segment; a zip nested two levels deep (e.g. out/myproject/index.html) will still miss. Consider suffix matching against manifest keys if that pattern shows up.
check_edits enforces the 10MB limit both via Content-Length pre-check and post-read length — correct; note that a chunked upload without Content-Length still buffers the full body before rejection.
GET /edit-diffs caps at 50 rows with no pagination; append-only growth will eventually truncate older history.
